title: CGAP Human Spleen Dissociation
author: Adam Hunter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qz3dx8n
materials: Slice spleen punch into small pieces (approximately 10x10x10mm).

Ensure all unused tissue, equipment and tubes that have been in contact with primary tissue are placed into Virkon in sweetie jar for a minimum of 1 hour. After this time aspirate and disposing in relevant sharps or waste routes.

steps.title: Freeze tissue in isopentane
steps.instruction: Freeze the human spleen tissue in isopentane before starting the dissociation protocol.

steps.title: Prepare spleen in PBS
steps.instruction: Place the spleen punch onto a 100 mm glass Petri dish, add cold PBS, and transfer to a Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Place spleen punch onto a 100 mm glass Petri dish.
Add 10 ml cold PBS to the dish.
Transfer spleen pieces and PBS into a 50 ml Falcon tube.

steps.title: Add DNase I
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl DNase I dropwise to the spleen suspension to reach a final concentration of 100 µg ml⁻¹.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Mash through cell strainer
steps.instruction: Disaggregate the tissue through a 100 µm cell strainer using a syringe plunger and wash with PBS.

substeps.instruction: Position a 100 µm cell strainer above a 50 ml Falcon tube.
Mash the spleen through the strainer using a 2.0 ml syringe plunger.
Wash the strainer with 10 ml cold PBS.

steps.title: Transfer to 15 ml tube
steps.instruction: Move the filtered suspension into a 15 ml Falcon tube.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Lyse red blood cells
steps.instruction: Add Red Cell Lysis buffer, resuspend the pellet, and incubate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml Red Cell Lysis buffer to the pellet and resuspend by racking/tapping.
Place the tube on ice for 5 min with periodic agitation.

steps.title: Wash with PBS
steps.instruction: Add cold PBS to the lysed sample.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend in BSA‑PBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA (8 µl BSA per ml PBS).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 5 ml cold PBS with 0.04 % BSA (8 µl BSA ml⁻¹).

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a 100 µm cell strainer into a Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Filter through a 100 µm cell strainer positioned above a 50 ml Falcon tube.

steps.title: Wash strainer
steps.instruction: Rinse the strainer with cold PBS‑BSA solution.

substeps.instruction: Wash the strainer with 5 ml cold PBS containing 0.04 % BSA (8 µl BSA ml⁻¹).

steps.title: Count cells
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration and viability using trypan blue and a C‑Chip or nucleocounter.

steps.title: Assess viability
steps.instruction: If live‑cell percentage >70‑80 % proceed; if <70‑80 % perform MACS Live/Dead separation per CGAP protocol.

steps.title: Dilute for 10X preparation
steps.instruction: Dilute cells to 2 × 10⁶ cells ml⁻¹ in 0.04 % BSA and continue with 10X scRNA‑seq library preparation.
